title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES STRENGTHENING THE OFFICE OF THE CABINET SECRETARY, ENHANCING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, PROVIDING FOR ITS SUPPORT STAFF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

text.en:
Enhancing the Capability of the OCS. For the effective discharge
of its functions, the following offices shall be organized under the OCS:
Office of Participatory Governance; and
Strategic Action and Response Office.

Office of Participatory Governance (OPG). The OPG shall
promote active citizenship, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability in
governance. It shall strive to achieve these goals by engaging the different sectors and
stakeholders to directly participate in governance and nation-building.
The OPG shall perform the following functions:
a. Promote and ensure the direct participation of various stakeholders in the
crafting and formulation of policies and programs to address concerns at the
grassroots level;
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

b. Initiate programs and projects that will facilitate citizen empowerment and
participation in governance at the national, regional, and local levels; and
c. Perform such other functions as may be necessary to achieve the above
stated goals of the OPG as directed by the Cabinet Secretary.

Strategic Action and Response (STAR) Office. The STAR Office
shall promote timely action and response to the concerns of the public. Its primary thrust
is to strengthen the current Presidential Action Center system and coordinate with
different agencies towards increasing timeliness and responsiveness of government
The Presidential Action Center is hereby renamed as Presidential Complaint
Center (PCC) which shall be under the direct control and supervision of the STAR
Office. The PCC shall establish and maintain a platform to receive requests, complaints,
and grievances from the general public, and refer them to the concerned government
The Public Concerns Office (PCO) under the Presidential Management Staff
(PMS) shall be transferred to the STAR Office, for its direct control and supervision. The
PCO shall institute feedback mechanisms to ensure that requests for assistance,
complaints, and grievances referred by the PCC are expeditiously acted upon by the
concerned agencies.
To further strengthen the STAR Office, there is also hereby organized a Quick
Response Center (QRC), which shall be under its control and supervision. The QRC
shall serve as the President's direct arm in coordinating with all concerned agencies to
immediately respond to critical incidents, crises or disasters

Cabinet Assistance System. The Cabinet Assistance System, as
established under Memorandum Order No. 96 (s. 1987), is hereby reinstated. The
Cabinet Secretary shall be responsible for convening the Cabinet Assistance System,
which shall handle priority areas or subjects that require special and immediate attention
as identified and recommended by the Department Secretaries.
The Presidential Management Staff (PMS) shall continue to assist the Cabinet
Secretary, in the exercise of his foregoing authority as convenor of the Cabinet
Assistance System, by:
a. developing and setting up the Cabinet Agenda, and the provision of
conterence and administrative support service, through the Cabinet Support
b. ensuring the delivery of Presidential instructions and compliance with Cabinet
meeting directives through the Directives Monitoring Office; and
c. performing such other functions as directed by the Cabinet Secretary.
The Cabinet Secretary shall have operational control over the Cabinet Support
Office and the Directives Monitoring Office in relation to policy direction and coordination
of Cabinet and other Presidential Meetings.

Performance and Projects Management Office (PPMO). The
powers, duties, and functions of the PPMO, as created under EO No. 99, shall continue
to be exercised and performed by the current PPMO. The Cabinet Secretary may, from
time to time, assign other specific powers, functions and tasks to the PPMO, in pursuit of
its mandate under EO No. 99.

Membership of OCS in the National Economic and
Development Authority (NDA) Board Committees. The Cabinet Secretary shall
remain as member of the NDA Board Executive Committee and the following NEDA
Board Inter-Agency Committees:
a. Investment Coordination Committee (ICC):
b. Social Development Committee (SDC); and
c. Infrastructure Committee (InfraCom).

Assistance from and Coordination with Government Agencies.
All heads of departments, agencies, bureaus, offices, including GOCCs shall continue to
render full and timely assistance and cooperation to the OCS and provide such
information and data as may be required to carry out its functions.

Organizational Setup and Staff Complement of the Different
Offices under the OCS. The Cabinet Secretary shall be assisted by Undersecretaries,
Assistant Secretaries, Directors, and such other officials and employees as may be
determined to be necessary.
The Cabinet Secretary shall, within fifteen (15) days from the approval of this
Order, submit the organizational structure and staffing pattern of the OCS to the DBM for
review and subsequent endorsement to the President, through the Office of the
Executive Secretary, for the President's approval.

Funding Support. The initial funds necessary for the
implementation of this Order shall be identified by the Department of Budget and
Management. The succeeding years' appropriations for the OCS shall be prepared in
accordance with regular government budget procedures.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is held invalid
or unconstitutional, the remainder not otherwise affected shall remain in full force and

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately
upon publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 1st day of December in the Year of our Lord
Two Thousand and Sixteen
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE
PHILIPPINE
